g.text: Replay the draw in your own browser
/replay/:programId re-checks eleven steps without trusting the server, then the fairness report is built only from what passed.
edit a copy: raise a family's priority, swap the randomness, move a placement, edit an audit
entry → the step that catches it turns red
Placements are read back from the database before they are published, so a matching replay shows the database holds exactly what the algorithm computed.
